# gpupaas_kubernetes_versions (Data Source)

The Kubernetes versions the controller offers for managed clusters, newest first. A cluster takes a minor such as `1.36` (the platform resolves it to the latest patch). This is the controller's catalogue: a Kubernetes SKU can allow fewer minors (for example the catalogue offers `1.37` while a SKU allows `1.34` to `1.36`). The minors a particular Kubernetes SKU allows are in `supported_kubernetes_versions` of `gpupaas_kubernetes_sku`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gpupaas_kubernetes_versions" "offered" {
  project = "system-catalog"
}

# The minors a cluster may ask for, newest first, and the one the controller preselects.
output "kubernetes_minors" {
  value = data.gpupaas_kubernetes_versions.offered.minors
}

output "default_kubernetes_version" {
  value = data.gpupaas_kubernetes_versions.offered.default_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) Project to ask in, usually `system-catalog`.

### Read-Only

- `default_version` (String) The minor version the controller preselects.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `minors` (List of String) The offered minor versions, newest first, for example `1.36`.
- `versions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `latest_patch` (String) The version a cluster gets when it asks for the minor, for example `v1.36.4`.
- `minor` (String)
